from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,timezone
import sys,os,json,hashlib,struct,subprocess,time,signal,math
root=Path('/home/server/liufengrong/robot_lab');skill=root/'.agents/skills/monitor-tune-isaaclab-training/scripts'
sys.path.insert(0,str(skill))
import collect_training_health as health
from algorithm_profiles import resolve_profile,load_registry,DEFAULT_REGISTRY_PATH
from evidence_provenance import encode,write_bytes
from tensorboard.compat.proto import event_pb2
from tensorboard.compat.tensorflow_stub.pywrap_tensorflow import masked_crc32c
launchpath=Path('/home/server/liufengrong/robot_lab/learnings/policy_tuning/RobotLab-Isaac-Velocity-Flat-LW-wheel-Roa-v0/2026-10-02_14-30-02/evidence/source/launch-wheel-live-model21000gpu1t-20261003-001.json')
assert hashlib.sha256(launchpath.read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='871336118c6f18affa60001890bd415aba3567f10841455e7004c66f39c76949'
launch=json.loads(launchpath.read_text());run=Path(launch['layout']['run_root']);log=root/'logs/rsl_rl/LW_wheel_flat_roa'/launch['layout']['run_id']
tb=next(log.glob('events.out.tfevents.*'));pid=launch['training_pid']
profile=resolve_profile(load_registry(DEFAULT_REGISTRY_PATH),'rsl-rl-roa')
def snapshot(phase,previous=None):
    assert Path(f'/proc/{pid}/cmdline').read_bytes().decode().rstrip('\0').split('\0')==launch['training_argv']
    with tb.open('rb') as stream:
        size=stream.seek(0,2);offset=max(0,size-2*1024*1024);stream.seek(offset);buf=stream.read()
    first=None
    for i in range(len(buf)-16):
        n=struct.unpack_from('<Q',buf,i)[0]
        if 0<n<524288 and i+16+n<=len(buf) and masked_crc32c(buf[i:i+8])==struct.unpack_from('<I',buf,i+8)[0] and masked_crc32c(buf[i+12:i+12+n])==struct.unpack_from('<I',buf,i+12+n)[0]:
            first=i;break
    assert first is not None
    i=first;records=0;series={}
    while i+16<=len(buf):
        n=struct.unpack_from('<Q',buf,i)[0]
        if i+16+n>len(buf):break
        assert masked_crc32c(buf[i:i+8])==struct.unpack_from('<I',buf,i+8)[0]
        payload=buf[i+12:i+12+n];assert masked_crc32c(payload)==struct.unpack_from('<I',buf,i+12+n)[0]
        event=event_pb2.Event.FromString(payload);records+=1
        for v in event.summary.value:
            if v.HasField('simple_value'):series.setdefault(v.tag,[]).append((int(event.step),float(v.simple_value),float(event.wall_time)))
        i+=16+n
    latest=max((values[-1][2],values[-1][0],tag) for tag,values in series.items())
    def bounded_progress(path):
        assert path==tb
        return {'path':str(tb),'available':True,'step':latest[1],'wall_time_unix':latest[0],'tag':latest[2],'error':None}
    original=health.tensorboard_progress;health.tensorboard_progress=bounded_progress
    try:
        value=health.collect_health(log_path=log/'stdout-unavailable.log',profile=profile,stale_after_seconds=120,pid=pid,expected_process_pattern='train.py',gpu_index=0,low_gpu_utilization_percent=5,tensorboard_path=tb,previous_health=previous)
    finally:health.tensorboard_progress=original
    metrics={}
    for tag,values in series.items():
        if any(s in tag for s in ['Loss/','mean_reward','mean_episode_length','error_vel','Perf/total_fps','estimated_velocity']):
            vals=values[-100:];metrics[tag]={'samples':len(vals),'first_step':vals[0][0],'last_step':vals[-1][0],'last':vals[-1][1],'mean':sum(x[1] for x in vals)/len(vals),'all_finite':all(math.isfinite(x[1]) for x in vals)}
            if tag=='Perf/total_fps':metrics[tag]['last20_mean']=sum(x[1] for x in vals[-20:])/len(vals[-20:])
    value['bounded_tensorboard_reader']={'method':'Two MiB tail, every accepted TFRecord header/payload CRC32C verified. Core collect_health unchanged; tensorboard_progress supplied verified bounded values in memory.','source_path':str(tb),'source_size':size,'offset':offset,'tail_sha256':hashlib.sha256(buf).hexdigest(),'records':records,'metrics':metrics}
    value['training_stdout_note']='Process stdout is terminal /dev/pts/2; no persistent stdout captured. Missing log path is explicit unavailable, no file created.'
    ref=write_bytes(run/'evidence/health'/('health-live21000gpu1t-'+phase+'-20261003-001.json'),encode(value))
    print(json.dumps({'phase':phase,'health':ref,'state':value['state'],'training_step':latest[1],'fps_last20_mean':metrics['Perf/total_fps']['last20_mean']}),flush=True)
    return value,ref
pre,pre_ref=snapshot('pre')
console=Path(launch['console_path'])
assert not console.exists();assert not Path(launch['layout']['paths']['play_result']).exists()
monitor={'version':1,'launch':{'path':str(launchpath),'sha256':'871336118c6f18affa60001890bd415aba3567f10841455e7004c66f39c76949'},'pre_health':pre_ref,'mid_health':[],'evaluator_pid':None,'stop_reason':None,'wall_timeout_s':launch['wall_timeout_s'],'guard_note':'Operational overlap guard: stop own evaluator on nonfinite train metrics, stall120s, or two consecutive last20 FPS snapshots below70% pre last20 mean. This is not policy acceptance criteria.'}
baseline_fps=pre['bounded_tensorboard_reader']['metrics']['Perf/total_fps']['last20_mean']
start=time.monotonic();previous=pre;next_check=start+20;checks=0;low=0
with console.open('x',encoding='utf-8') as stream:
    stream.write(json.dumps({'argv':launch['evaluation_argv']})+'\n');stream.flush()
    child=subprocess.Popen(launch['evaluation_argv'],cwd=root,stdout=stream,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,start_new_session=True,env=dict(os.environ,**launch.get('evaluator_environment',{})))
    monitor['evaluator_pid']=child.pid
    print(json.dumps({'evaluation_started':child.pid,'checkpoint':launch['checkpoint'],'console':str(console)}),flush=True)
    try:
        while child.poll() is None:
            now=time.monotonic()
            if now-start>launch['wall_timeout_s']:monitor['stop_reason']='bounded_wall_timeout';break
            if now>=next_check:
                checks+=1;current,reference=snapshot('mid'+str(checks),previous);previous=current;monitor['mid_health'].append(reference)
                metrics=current['bounded_tensorboard_reader']['metrics'];fps=metrics['Perf/total_fps']['last20_mean'];low=low+1 if fps<.70*baseline_fps else 0
                if any(not x['all_finite'] for x in metrics.values()):monitor['stop_reason']='nonfinite_training_metric';break
                if current['state'] in ['stalled','stopped','unknown']:monitor['stop_reason']='training_health_'+current['state'];break
                if low>=2:monitor['stop_reason']='material_training_throughput_drop';break
                next_check=now+20
            time.sleep(.25)
        if monitor['stop_reason'] and child.poll() is None:
            assert os.getpgid(child.pid)==child.pid and child.pid!=pid
            os.killpg(child.pid,signal.SIGTERM)
            try:child.wait(timeout=10)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:os.killpg(child.pid,signal.SIGKILL);child.wait()
        else:child.wait()
    except BaseException:
        if child.poll() is None:
            assert os.getpgid(child.pid)==child.pid and child.pid!=pid
            os.killpg(child.pid,signal.SIGTERM)
            try:child.wait(timeout=10)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:os.killpg(child.pid,signal.SIGKILL);child.wait()
        raise
post,post_ref=snapshot('post',previous);monitor['post_health']=post_ref;monitor['elapsed_wall_s']=time.monotonic()-start;monitor['returncode']=child.returncode
monitor['result_published']=Path(launch['layout']['paths']['play_result']).is_file()
monitor['training_pre_post_steps']=[pre['progress']['tensorboard']['step'],post['progress']['tensorboard']['step']]
monitor['training_last20_fps_pre_post']=[baseline_fps,post['bounded_tensorboard_reader']['metrics']['Perf/total_fps']['last20_mean']]
monitor['training_signalled']=False;monitor['finished_at']=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
ref=write_bytes(run/'evidence/source/overlap-monitor-wheel-live-model21000gpu1t-20261003-001.json',encode(monitor))
print(json.dumps({'monitor':ref,'returncode':child.returncode,'stop_reason':monitor['stop_reason'],'result_published':monitor['result_published'],'training_steps':monitor['training_pre_post_steps'],'elapsed_s':monitor['elapsed_wall_s']}),flush=True)
